bosses.name: Atal'alarion
bosses.general: Raised by touching the statues in the pit in the right order: Sweeping Slam and Knock Away.
bosses.tank: Face him away, back to a wall.

bosses.name: Jammal'an the Prophet
bosses.general: With Ogom the Wretched: Hex of Jammal'an turns a player against us, Healing Wave, totems.
bosses.healer: Dispel or crowd control the hexed player.
bosses.dps: Interrupt his Healing Wave; kill Jammal'an, then Ogom.

bosses.name: Ogom the Wretched
bosses.general: Jammal'an's shadow caster: Shadow Bolt and Curse of Weakness.

bosses.name: Dreamscythe
bosses.general: Green dragonkin on the balcony: Acid Breath in front and Wing Flap.
bosses.tank: Face it away from the group.

bosses.name: Weaver
bosses.general: Green dragonkin: Acid Breath in front and Wing Flap.
bosses.tank: Face it away from the group.

bosses.name: Morphaz
bosses.general: Dragonkin: Acid Breath in front and Thrash.

bosses.name: Avatar of Hakkar
bosses.general: Event: kill the Hakkari Bloodkeepers and use their blood to put out the Eternal Flames, then the Avatar comes: Cause Insanity, Curse of Tongues, Lash.
bosses.tank: Face him away; crowd control a player he drives insane.
bosses.dps: Bloodkeepers first in the event, then the Avatar.

bosses.name: Shade of Eranikus
bosses.general: Green dragon: Acid Breath in front, War Stomp, and Deep Slumber puts people to sleep.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the group.
bosses.healer: Dispel the sleep; nature resistance helps.
